description: Backend / packages / harness / CI Shadow Technical Decisions

decisions.title: Package-Driven Architecture
decisions.rule: Git-managed HA business logic MUST reside exclusively under Edge /config/packages/ via Whitelist CD. Direct agent edits to automations.yaml / scripts.yaml / configuration.yaml on Edge are forbidden.

decisions.title: Path-Based Differential Deployment
decisions.rule: Frontend-only Change Sets sync without ha core restart. Backend package Change Sets enforce ha core restart. Restart is driven by git source paths, not build/staging/**.

decisions.title: RFC 6902 Delta Mutations
decisions.rule: JSON registries mutate via validated RFC 6902 patches through the Execution Harness. YAML templates remain full-file overwrite. Append-only event stream records successful JSON applies.

decisions.title: Swarm Map-Reduce Context Partitioning
decisions.rule: Multi-zone / multi-domain intents decompose via topology or device_type axes. Sub-agents return RFC 6902 deltas only; reduce via aggregate_swarm_deltas with policy + conflict checks.
